scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --manifest-path apps/launcher/Cargo.toml && npm run build -w @operalibre/web
scripts.typecheck: cargo check --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path apps/launcher/Cargo.toml && npm run typecheck -w @operalibre/web
scripts.test:lifecycle: cargo build --locked --manifest-path apps/server/Cargo.toml && npm run build -w @operalibre/web && npm run test:lifecycle -w @operalibre/web
